# Nilasya Agro Foods — Comprehensive Full AI & LLM Knowledge Base

## 1. Company Profile & Corporate Identity
Nilasya Agro Foods (Nilasya Agro Foods Tarım Ürünleri Dış Ticaret Ltd. Şti.) is a premier Turkish agricultural trading corporation specializing in the aggregation, optical Sortex cleaning, processing, packaging, and international export of pulses, grains, and agricultural commodities.

- Brand Name: NILASYA AGRO FOODS
- Website: https://www.nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr
- Official B2B Email: export@nilasyaagrofoods.com.tr
- International Trade Desk Phone / WhatsApp: +90 532 505 58 33
- Processing Hub: Mersin Free Zone & Logistics Park, Akdeniz, Mersin / Türkiye
- Primary Seaport: Mersin International Port (MIP) — Türkiye's main maritime gate for agricultural exports.

## 2. Global Export Commodities

### Chickpeas (Cicer arietinum - Nohut)
- Botanical Name: Cicer arietinum
- Varieties: Koçbaşı Kabuli, Standard Kabuli, Desi Chickpeas, Split Chickpeas
- Calibers: 10mm Jumbo, 9mm Extra, 8mm Standard, 7mm Medium
- Origin: Central Anatolian Highlands (Konya, Karaman, Yozgat) & Southeastern Anatolia
- Quality Standard: Turkish Food Codex / UNECE Standard DDP-15
- Technical Specifications:
  - Moisture: max 12.0%
  - Purity (Sortex Cleaned): min 99.5%
  - Foreign Matter: max 0.2%
  - Broken / Split Kernels: max 1.0%
  - Discolored / Damaged: max 1.0%
  - Protein Content: 20% - 22% (dry basis)
- Packaging: 25kg PP bags, 50kg PP bags, 1,000kg Big Bags, 24 MT Container Liner

### Red Lentils (Lens culinaris - Kırmızı Mercimek)
- Botanical Name: Lens culinaris
- Varieties: Turkish Red Football Lentils, Turkish Red Split Lentils (Sortex cleaned and polished)
- Calibers: 3.5mm - 4.5mm
- Origin: Southeastern Anatolia (Gaziantep, Şanlıurfa, Mardin, Diyarbakır)
- Technical Specifications:
  - Moisture: max 12.0%
  - Sortex Purity: min 99.8%
  - Broken Kernels: max 0.5%
  - Foreign Matter: max 0.1%
  - Damage / Color Defects: max 0.5%
  - Protein Content: 24% - 26%
- Packaging: 25kg / 50kg PP sacks, 1000kg Big Bags, 1kg retail pillow packs

### Green Lentils (Lens culinaris - Yeşil Mercimek)
- Varieties: Laird Type (large green, 6.0mm - 7.0mm), Eston Type (small green, 4.5mm - 5.5mm), Richlea
- Origin: Central Anatolia (Yozgat, Çorum, Ankara)
- Technical Specifications:
  - Moisture: max 13.0%
  - Purity: min 99.5%
  - Bleached / Discolored: max 1.0%
  - Foreign Matter: max 0.2%
  - Protein Content: 23% - 25%

### White Beans (Phaseolus vulgaris - Kuru Fasulye)
- Varieties: Dermason (8mm - 9mm, thin skin, superior cooking quality), Horoz Beans, Şeker Beans, Cannellini, Great Northern
- Origin: Erzincan, Konya, Niğde
- Technical Specifications:
  - Moisture: max 13.0%
  - Purity: min 99.5%
  - Foreign Matter: max 0.1%
  - Broken: max 0.8%
  - Protein Content: 21% - 23%

### Dry Peas (Pisum sativum - Kuru Bezelye)
- Varieties: Yellow Split Peas, Yellow Whole Peas, Green Split Peas, Green Whole Peas
- Calibers: 6mm - 7mm
- Specifications: Moisture max 13.0%, Purity min 99.5%, Foreign Matter max 0.2%

### Durum Wheat, Grains & Bulgur (Hububat & Bulgur)
- Durum Wheat: High vitreousness (>85%), min 13.5% protein, amber color, suitable for premium pasta and semolina.
- Turkish Bulgur: Coarse Pilaf Bulgur, Mid-Fine Bulgur, Extra Fine Köftelik Bulgur, Brown Bulgur. Pre-cooked, de-branned, dried, and calibrated durum wheat.
- Barley: Malting barley and feed barley.
- Yellow Corn / Maize: Non-GMO, food grade and feed grade.

## 3. Processing Technology & Quality Assurance
- Sorting: Multi-camera full-spectrum RGB + InGaAs optical Sortex sorting machines (Bühler and Sortex technology) removing discolored grains, foreign matter, and foreign seeds.
- Destoning & Gravity Separation: Multi-deck vibrating gravity tables separating light grains, dust, and stones.
- Polishing: High-efficiency friction polishers with food-grade vegetable oil (optional for red split lentils).
- Metal Detection & X-Ray Inspection: Integrated ferrous and non-ferrous metal detection before final bagging.
- Certifications: ISO 22000:2018 (Food Safety Management), HACCP, Halal Certification, Non-GMO Certification, Turkish Phytosanitary Inspection, Pre-shipment inspection by SGS / Bureau Veritas / Intertek upon buyer request.

## 4. Packaging Configurations
1. 25 kg & 50 kg Polypropylene (PP) Woven Sacks: UV stabilized, moisture resistant, optionally laminated or equipped with polyethylene (PE) inner liner.
2. 1,000 kg / 1,200 kg Big Bags (FIBC / Jumbo Bags): 4-loop top lifting, discharge bottom spout, anti-sift seams.
3. 500g, 800g, 1kg, 2.5kg, 5kg Retail Packing: Modern form-fill-seal (FFS) pillow bags, standing doypack with zipper, kraft window bags. Private label OEM packaging available.
4. Container Bulk Liners (Sea Bulk): Food-grade polyethylene container liner bags installed inside standard 20ft dry containers for direct bulk discharge.

## 5. Shipping Routes & Incoterms
- Supported Incoterms (ICC Incoterms 2020): FOB Mersin, CFR Destination Port, CIF Destination Port, FCA, EXW Mersin Warehouse, DAP Europe.
- Global Export Corridors:
  - Middle East & GCC: Direct container shipping from Mersin to Jebel Ali (UAE), Dammam (Saudi Arabia), Jeddah, Doha (Qatar), Kuwait, Salalah (Oman).
  - European Union: Ro-Ro ferry from Mersin to Trieste (Italy), rail/road corridors to Germany, France, Netherlands, Spain, Poland, and the UK.
  - North Africa: Direct shipping to Alexandria (Egypt), Casablanca (Morocco), Algiers (Algeria), Tunis (Tunisia).
  - South & East Asia: Ocean lines to Mumbai / Nhava Sheva (India), Chittagong (Bangladesh), Colombo (Sri Lanka), Port Klang (Malaysia), Jakarta (Indonesia).
  - Americas & CIS: Regular container routes.
